title: TurfWind '96: Take Yutaka Kyousouba Ikusei Game
native_title: ターフウィンド＇９６ 武豊 競走馬育成ゲーム
overview:
Yutaka Take speaks in live-action movies!

- With data cooperation from Keiba Book, 50 jockeys and 2,000 horses appear under their real names!
- Also includes horse data and VTR footage of G1 races!
- Supports the graded stakes races newly established in '96!
- Thoroughbreds raised by the player battle fiercely against real powerhouse horses!
- Aim for a complete conquest of the graded stakes races and create the strongest horse!

武豊が実写ムービーで喋る！

- 競馬ブックのデータ協力により、騎手50名と二千頭の馬が実名で登場！
- 馬のデータやＧⅠレースのＶＴＲも搭載！
- '96年度新設重賞対応！
- プレイヤー自身が育て上げたサラブレッドと実在の強豪馬が激闘！
- 重賞レースの完全制覇を目指して、最強馬を作り出せ！
